scope: active = docs files not under /archive/ (ratchet gate); total = all docs

filters.placeholder: refs containing '<', '>' or '*' are excluded (e.g. docs/specs/<name>.spec.md, docs/plans/*.md)
filters.archiveAware: docs/specs/<name> and docs/plans/<name> also check docs/<type>/archive/<name> so archiving does not spuriously trip the gate; legacy .imm/specs/* also checks archive

note: active includes the five active Specs of the managed-workflow-simplification Initiative, whose scope-bound archive pair is required by the Kernel and does not exist until each task freezes; total raised 847 -> 854 on 2026-10-08 for the imm-loop/imm-agent-doc-maintain/imm-review-retro Skill rename (#163): archived Plans and Specs keep the old skills/<name>/SKILL.md paths as historical records, active is unchanged; raised active 139 -> 198 and total 854 -> 1152 on 2026-10-28 for the bare-verb Skill rename (#318, ADR 0031): every added finding is a dated Plan, Spec, report or solution that keeps an old skills/imm-<name>/SKILL.md path as a historical record; the current surface adds none
